artifacts.title: Floor nomination procedure for the office of Stated Clerk
artifacts.disposition: floor nominations follow identical procedure to other contested offices; nominees must be examined by TEC; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: CCB advised that floor nominations for Stated Clerk follow the same procedure as other contested offices, and nominees must be examined by the Theological Examining Committee.

artifacts.title: Assembly committee and agency members as non-voting advisors under BCO 14-1

matches.evidence: The CCB found the proposed amendment making AC members from committees and agencies non-voting advisory members not in conflict with the Constitution.

artifacts.title: Changes in permanent committee and agency policy under BCO 14-1

artifacts.title: Overture requiring all BCO changes referred to CCB and Bills and Overtures

matches.evidence: The CCB found this overture in conflict with RAO 13-1 and BCO 14-1, which permit BCO amendments of a particular nature to be referred to other committees and allow proposals to arise from other Assembly reports.

artifacts.title: Overture to abolish the Standing Judicial Commission

matches.evidence: The CCB found the overture to abolish the SJC in conflict with BCO 14-1 and 15, and also unconstitutionally vague about the basis for alternative decisions.
